    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, kernel_size, padding):
        super().__init__()
        self.depthwise = nn.Conv1d(
            in_ch, in_ch, kernel_size, padding=padding, groups=in_ch
        )
        self.pointwise = nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, 1)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch)
        self.act = nn.SiLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.depthwise(x)
        x = self.pointwise(x)
        return self.act(self.bn(x))


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, kernel_size, padding, downsample=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = DepthwiseSeparableConv(in_ch, out_ch, kernel_size, padding)
        self.conv2 = DepthwiseSeparableConv(out_ch, out_ch, kernel_size, padding)
        self.se = SEBlock(out_ch)
        self.downsample = downsample

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        if self.downsample:
            residual = self.downsample(x)

        x = self.conv1(x)
        x = self.conv2(x)
        x = self.se(x)
        return x + residual

            ResBlock(
                64,

                5,

                downsample=nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(64, 128, 1), nn.BatchNorm1d(128)),
            ),
            ResBlock(128, 256, 5, 2),
            nn.MaxPool1d(4),
            ResBlock(256, 512, 3, 1),
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 6),
        )

    def forward(self, x):

        x = self.resblocks(x)

class EEGDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, eeg_dir, spec_dir):
        self.df = df
        self.eeg_dir = eeg_dir
        self.spec_dir = spec_dir
        self.vote_cols = [
            "seizure_vote",
            "lpd_vote",
            "gpd_vote",
            "lrda_vote",
            "grda_vote",
            "other_vote",
        ]
        self.eeg_cache = {}
        self.spec_cache = {}

        sample_spec = pd.read_parquet(
            os.path.join(spec_dir, f"{df.iloc[0]['spectrogram_id']}.parquet")
        )
        self.spec_channels = len(sample_spec.columns)

        targets = self.df[self.vote_cols].values
        self.targets = targets / (targets.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]

        # Process EEG
        eeg_id = row["eeg_id"]
        if eeg_id not in self.eeg_cache:
            eeg = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(self.eeg_dir, f"{eeg_id}.parquet"))
            eeg = eeg[[c for c in eeg.columns if c != "EKG"]]
            self.eeg_cache[eeg_id] = np.nan_to_num(eeg.values.astype(np.float32))

        eeg_data = self.eeg_cache[eeg_id]
        offset = int(row["eeg_label_offset_seconds"] * 200)
        end = min(offset + 10000, eeg_data.shape[0])
        eeg_segment = eeg_data[offset:end].T

        if eeg_segment.shape[1] < 10000:
            pad_width = ((0, 0), (0, 10000 - eeg_segment.shape[1]))
            eeg_segment = np.pad(eeg_segment, pad_width, mode="constant")

        eeg_segment = (eeg_segment - eeg_segment.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)) / (
            eeg_segment.std(axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6
        )

        # Process Spectrogram
        spec_id = row["spectrogram_id"]
        if spec_id not in self.spec_cache:
            spec = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(self.spec_dir, f"{spec_id}.parquet"))
            self.spec_cache[spec_id] = np.nan_to_num(spec.values.astype(np.float32))

        spec_data = self.spec_cache[spec_id]
        offset_spec = int(row["spectrogram_label_offset_seconds"])
        start = max(0, offset_spec - 5)
        end = min(spec_data.shape[0], offset_spec + 5)
        spec_segment = spec_data[start:end].T

        if spec_segment.shape[1] < 10:
            pad_width = ((0, 0), (0, 10 - spec_segment.shape[1]))
            spec_segment = np.pad(spec_segment, pad_width, mode="constant")

        spec_segment = (spec_segment - spec_segment.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)) / (
            spec_segment.std(axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6
        )

        return (
            torch.FloatTensor(eeg_segment),
            torch.FloatTensor(spec_segment),
        ), torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])


class DualModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.eeg_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(19, 32, 5, 2, 2),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            nn.Conv1d(32, 64, 5, 2, 2),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            nn.Conv1d(64, 128, 5, 2, 2),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
        )
        self.spec_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(spec_channels, 32, 3, 1, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            nn.Conv1d(32, 64, 3, 1, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            nn.Conv1d(64, 128, 3, 1, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
        )
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3), nn.Linear(64, 6)
        )

    def forward(self, x_eeg, x_spec):
        eeg_feat = self.eeg_net(x_eeg)
        spec_feat = self.spec_net(x_spec)
        return nn.functional.log_softmax(
            self.head(torch.cat([eeg_feat, spec_feat], 1)), dim=1
        )

class MultiModalDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, eeg_dir, spec_dir, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.eeg_dir = eeg_dir
        self.spec_dir = spec_dir
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]

        # Process EEG
        eeg_path = f"{self.eeg_dir}/{row.eeg_id}.parquet"
        eeg = pd.read_parquet(eeg_path).values.T
        eeg = np.nan_to_num(eeg, nan=0.0)

        if self.is_test:
            if eeg.shape[1] < 10000:

            else:

            else:

        eeg = (eeg - eeg.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)) / (
            eeg.std(axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6

        eeg = torch.FloatTensor(eeg)

        # Process Spectrogram

        # Extract central 10 seconds from 10-minute spectrogram
        center_start = 295  # (600-10)//2

        spec = (spec - spec.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)) / (
            spec.std(axis=0, keepdims=True) + 1e-6
        )
        spec = torch.FloatTensor(spec)

        if self.is_test:
            return eeg, spec
        votes = row[TARGETS].values.astype(np.float32)
        return eeg, spec, torch.FloatTensor(votes / (votes.sum() + 1e-6))

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # EEG Branch
        self.eeg_block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(20, 64, 11, stride=4, padding=5, groups=4),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(64),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(3, 2, padding=1),

        self.spec_block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(20, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1),

            nn.MaxPool1d(2),

            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 128, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3), nn.Linear(256, 6)
        )

    def forward(self, eeg, spec):
        eeg_feat = self.eeg_block(eeg).squeeze(-1)
        spec_feat = self.spec_block(spec).squeeze(-1)
        combined = torch.cat([eeg_feat, spec_feat], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined)
